PF1AURAS.Sheet.Title: Aura
PF1AURAS.Sheet.Enabled: Share this buff as an aura
PF1AURAS.Sheet.ChildNote: Shared by an aura. Edit the source buff instead.
PF1AURAS.Settings.hpFallback.Name: Stop auras below 0 HP
PF1AURAS.Settings.hpFallback.Hint: Only for worlds without condition automation. Auras normally stop when the emitter is unconscious or dead.
PF1AURAS.Settings.quietWindow.Name: Settle delay (ms)
PF1AURAS.Settings.quietWindow.Hint: Wait this long after movement stops before applying full auras.
PF1AURAS.Settings.settleCeiling.Name: Maximum settle wait (ms)
PF1AURAS.Settings.settleCeiling.Hint: Apply anyway once this long has passed, for tokens that never stop moving.
PF1AURAS.Settings.fastDebounce.Name: Aura edit delay (ms)
PF1AURAS.Settings.fastDebounce.Hint: How quickly edits to an aura buff reach the copies. Not affected by movement.
